extraction.title_anon: Company vehicles, road tax dispute, [name] [name] (not an accident claim)
extraction.family_summary: This is not a road accident compensation case. A logistics company working inside a steel plant in [name] [name] asked to be excused from motor vehicle tax for 36 vehicles kept within the plant's closed yard, and paid Rs 22,71,700 under protest. A single judge of the [name] [name] High Court ordered a refund in June 2023, a division bench reversed that in December 2024, and in August 2025 the Supreme Court restored the refund order.
what_mattered: No accident compensation was decided; the case is about road tax on vehicles used only inside a closed industrial yard.
The Court held the state tax applies only to vehicles used or kept for use in a 'public place', and a guarded yard the public cannot enter is not one, even without a written non-use notice.
